name: Kingsley Shyne Mattis Sogorb
summary: Tools Programmer specializing in Unreal Engine, C++, editor workflows, and production-focused automation. Experience building custom editor tooling, data-driven asset systems, reflection-based workflows, and pipeline utilities that improve iteration speed, usability for content teams, and runtime/editor separation. Strong focus on reusable architecture, technical UX, and scalable workflow design.

experience.title: Plugin Developer (Unreal Engine)
points: Designed and implemented custom Unreal Engine editor tooling for data-driven content workflows and modular asset configuration.
Built reflection-based systems and custom details panels to expose complex data in a more usable form for designers and artists.
Created editor/runtime separation patterns and shipping-optimized data layouts to keep tools flexible in editor while minimizing runtime overhead.
Developed workflow-oriented UI and preview systems to improve iteration speed and reduce manual setup work.

experience.title: Systems and Mechanics Programmer at Avtrix Games (Unreal Engine)
points: Implemented a wide range of gameplay and editor-facing systems, including modular interaction, weapon configuration, and character-environment workflows.
Built data-driven content pipelines exposing gameplay parameters to non-programmers for faster tuning and iteration.
Automated repetitive production tasks with Python scripts for batch processing such as texture resizing and filtering.
Developed custom FX and material setups, plus tools-oriented exposure of parameters to support artists during production.
Worked on technical systems with modular design to improve maintainability, reuse, and scalability across content-heavy features.

experience.title: Gameplay Programmer Intern at Devilish Games (Unity)
points: Developed gameplay prototypes with custom movement and mathematical control systems for mobile projects.
Implemented mechanics involving 3D/2D hybrid interaction, precision-based control, and gravity-driven race concepts.
Built fast-iteration prototype systems to validate mechanics and support early production decisions.

Implemented prototype logic designed for rapid iteration and mechanics validation.
